# NOT generated by the Astro build: tools/sync.mjs copies only the listed route groups
# and sitemap*.xml out of dist/, so a file in site-src/public/ would never reach the root.
#
# The sitemap below is generated and covers the whole published site — the Astro routes plus
# the hand-written pages, which site-src/astro.config.mjs lists explicitly as customPages.
#
# CORRECTED 2026-08-24. This used to say /graphs was "built but not published" and that advertising
# it would point crawlers at a permanent "not on this server" page. That stopped being true when
# /graphs became a viewer for our own EARS Pro curves: it has been live and nav-linked for weeks,
# and it carries no noindex. It is now in the sitemap. The only pages held out are /canjam and
# /card, which are noindex QR targets for printed handouts.
